**Authorization:** William Edgar Brissey, 30 August 2026, 14:24 Asia/Manila.

This page is a **coverage and uncertainty board**. It is not a finding that any band sustains more life, that relocation is warranted, or that EDEN is viable.

Client incident files stay out of this corpus.

Compare **calendar month to the same calendar month** (July vs July 1991–2020), not to an annual mean and not to Paris.

## CHIRPS limit

CHIRPS v2 global monthly is a 0.05° grid from 50N to 50S. Calling it “global water” without that bound is false. Paris is the extra-tropical control and sits near that edge.

## FIRMS west_south

On 2026-08-30 the west_south box (`-180,-90,0,0`) returned **0** rows while east_north returned **4116**. That is `NO_COVERAGE` / adapter defect for that box, not “no fire in the western south.”

## Lag

CHIRPS latest published month at last check was **2026.07**. August is `DELAYED`, not zero rain.
